_comment: Editable rules for STP Investment Services (BluePrint) document names. The portal's report already says WHICH KIND a document is (Document_Type_Name: Capital Call Notice / K-1 / Partner Capital Statement / ...) and which curated folder it lives in (Investor Reporting / Tax / Onboarding / Fund Materials); the app files by the folder and keeps the document's own name as the summary, so these rules exist only for wording tweaks and are nearly empty. NOTE: agreements (Subscription Agreement, Operating Agreement) are IN scope on this portal - do not add an 'agreement' skip pattern.
